claims.source_fact: The catalog source contains the gryphon-patrol identifier and a cover path containing cover-gryphon-patrol.png.
claims.interpretation: The frozen catalog identifies the historical game as Gryphon Patrol.

claims.source_fact: The client page dynamically imports GryphonPatrolGame, requests gryphon-patrol sentences, posts completion, fetches rankings, and renders game and rankings tabs.
claims.interpretation: This historical page is the game route composition and API caller.

claims.source_fact: The component renders a start screen for status start, a React-Konva stage for playing/won/lost, and victory or defeat end screens for won or lost.
claims.interpretation: The component defines start, active, and terminal visual compositions.

claims.source_fact: The start screen supplies title Gryphon Patrol, a patrol subtitle, three instruction strings, and START PATROL; terminal screens supply Mission Accomplished! and Gryphon Down! titles.
claims.interpretation: These are historical UI copy strings, not a current-browser observation.

claims.source_fact: The Jest test mocks Konva and shared hooks and names tests for initial start rendering, start transition, fullscreen entry, requestAnimationFrame, terminal screens, and one rAF callback.
claims.interpretation: Historical test intent covers component surface transitions under mocks; it is not runtime proof.

claims.source_fact: GameState declares start, playing, won, lost, and paused statuses; its initializer sets start; tick sets lost when HP is nonpositive and won when collected word count equals sentence length.
claims.interpretation: The historical state model has source-defined start-to-playing setup and tick-controlled won/lost terminal transitions.

claims.source_fact: Input changes player velocity; tick wraps x by mapWidth, clamps y by gameHeight, applies friction, moves enemies, and bounces enemy y velocity at vertical bounds.
claims.interpretation: The historical logic implements aerial patrol movement in a horizontally wrapping arena; no source fact names an escort mechanic.

claims.source_fact: Enemy spawn marks the first sentence word as target; projectile collisions call hitGryphonPatrolEnemy; correct target hits create active word orbs; player-enemy collisions decrement HP with one-second invulnerability.
claims.interpretation: The historical mechanic combines target selection, projectiles, collectible word orbs, and health loss.

claims.source_fact: The component reads container client dimensions on resize and scales a 390 by 844 stage by the smaller width or height ratio; the page uses sm and md Tailwind variants.
claims.interpretation: The source contains responsive composition logic; no browser observation is asserted.

claims.source_fact: GRYPHON_PATROL_CONFIG defines gameWidth 390, gameHeight 844, mapWidth 2000, player speed and size, enemy count/speed/size, orb size, colors, and friction.
claims.interpretation: This directly imported historical configuration governs the logic constants.

claims.source_fact: The sentences route exports GET from createSentencesRoute with eleven literal sentence and translation records.
claims.interpretation: This historical API source supplies sentence data.

claims.source_fact: The complete route exports POST from createCompleteRoute.
claims.interpretation: This is the historical completion endpoint wrapper.

claims.source_fact: The ranking route exports GET from createRankingRoute.
claims.interpretation: This is the historical rankings endpoint wrapper.

claims.source_fact: The cartridge exports gryphonPatrolCartridge via createArenaCartridge with arenaWaveBlueprints[3], the title Gryphon Patrol, and a minimap sentence-arena description.
claims.interpretation: This is a separate historical cartridge representation and may not describe the deleted component exactly.
